key_insight: Training language models on evidence-linked scientific reasoning helped guide perovskite solar-cell design, with a model-selected contact enabling 27.05% power conversion efficiency.
engineering_relevance: Evidence-grounded AI could help engineers prioritize contact materials and design discriminating experiments for more efficient, thermally stable perovskite devices.
method: Reconstruct expert-calibrated evidence records from 4,035 articles, linking strategies, controls and observations to mechanisms.
Adapt OpenPerov using structured evidence rather than conventional question-answer training.
Refine selected answers with retrieved evidence and experimentally test a recommended self-assembled monolayer contact.
evidence_signal: On the 800-question PSM-Bench, OpenPerov Flash ranked first among 13 closed-book systems; experimentally, the model-selected K analogue outperformed the expert-preferred Na analogue, with devices retaining 96.74% efficiency after 1,000 hours of dark thermal ageing at 85°C.
watch_item: The reported validation does not establish generalization across other material systems or durability under illuminated operating conditions.
paper_title: Evidence-grounded large language models guide perovskite solar cell design and optimization
